data.name: Ajab
data.gender_notes: Ajab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ajaba' meaning 'to astonish, to be strange or wonderful', Ajab is a name that evokes a sense of awe and admiration. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name was given to Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) when he was thrown into the fire and emerged unharmed, leaving the people amazed and in a state of wonder.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the mystery and wonder of God's creation.
data.etymology: Ajab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wonder, Amazement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajab total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: عجب

It serves as a reminder of the Prophet's unwavering faith in Allah and his willingness to submit to His will, no matter the consequences. This name can also be seen as a source of inspiration for individuals to persevere through tough times and to remain steadfast in their beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ajab holds a deep spiritual significance as it represents the sense of wonder and awe we should feel towards Allah and His endless mercy and compassion. it is a reminder of the Prophet's closeness to Allah and the amazement that comes from recognizing the divine plan in even the most difficult of circumstances.
